primary: Paired AR versus selected candidate, same prompts/chattemplate/precision/seed/context/outputcap; actual checkpoint tokenizer applied at run time. Start32 then64/256 as resident time budget permits; preserve incomplete and report coverage.
admission: Compute actual input token length including chat template before execution. No silent question truncation or dropped cases. If input+max_new exceeds native capacity, report capacity rejection/coverage and assess separately, not lower candidate cap only.
stop: Natural EOS or cap512, all caps remain in denominator; save result/case immediately; leave cleanup150s before job deadline.
quality: Score final task answer and numeric equivalence, not token identity; use same answer extraction as paired baseline, inspect parse failures. Record correct/EOS/cap/error/unfinished separately; Wilson interval and paired correctness discordances. 256questions alone not universal noninferiority proof.
scope: Nativeemitter timings unless separately HTTPtested; thinking/control tokens included and visibleanswer count separate when supported. Aggregate/C not peruser speed.
